takeaways: Cooling US inflation and declining Treasury yields are boosting market sentiment, though persistent core price pressures and geopolitical risks in the Middle East continue to temper risk appetite.

The AI sector faces a divergence between rapid innovation in China and leadership instability at OpenAI, while institutional capital aggressively targets high-density data center infrastructure for valuation growth.

Global EV sales are fragmenting as North American demand falters and manufacturers prioritize margin preservation, contrasting with the structural shift toward gold as a hedge against dedollarization.
day_verdict: Major day — market-moving events; read carefully.

items.title: Global markets welcome moderate US inflation but Mideast uncertainties limit optimism
bullets: US annual inflation cooled to 3.4% with core inflation hitting a multi-month low of 2.5%, significantly reducing market expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes in 2026.
Geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and uncertainty regarding the extension of the US-Iran ceasefire continue to cap risk appetite despite positive momentum in AI-driven tech equities.
items.reason: Direct impact on Fed policy expectations and global risk sentiment.

items.title: Forging Indonesia’s Gold Chain: From Underground Reserves to Central Bank Vaults
bullets: Indonesia holds 3,600 metric tons of gold reserves but maintains only 87.1 metric tons in official central bank holdings, highlighting a significant potential for domestic reserve accumulation.

Financial authorities are under pressure to shift away from heavy reliance on USD-denominated foreign exchange reserves, potentially signaling a long-term structural shift toward gold as a hedge against dedollarization.
items.reason: Highlights a potential shift in central bank reserve management strategies in emerging markets.

items.title: Non-farm payrolls ignite gold rally, while central bank purchases provide support
bullets: Recent non-farm payroll data has acted as a catalyst for a gold price rally, supported by sustained central bank buying activity that provides a floor for the precious metal.
Market participants are shifting focus toward upcoming commentary from Fed officials at Jackson Hole to determine if the current gold rebound can sustain a secondary bull market trajectory.
items.reason: Signals a critical technical and fundamental inflection point for gold markets.

items.title: ONDS Stock Drops After Earnings – CEO Expects ‘Sustained Momentum’, Raises 2026 Revenue Outlook To $550M
bullets: Ondas Holdings reported record Q2 revenue of $83.8 million, significantly exceeding the $68 million analyst consensus and marking a 13-fold increase compared to the same period last year.
Despite the revenue growth, the company reported a widened adjusted EBITDA loss of $50.6 million and a gross margin decline to 43.1%, leading to a 5% drop in share price.
items.reason: Strong revenue growth coupled with margin compression and stock volatility.

items.title: Applied Materials stock jumps ahead of Q3 earnings
bullets: Applied Materials shares rose 4% ahead of its fiscal Q3 report, with analysts projecting revenue of $8.99 billion and adjusted earnings of $3.36 per share, representing 23% and 36% year-over-year growth respectively.
Investors are closely monitoring the report for signs of sustained demand from advanced logic and memory customers, as options markets imply a potential 7.4% move in the stock following the release.
items.reason: High market anticipation for a key semiconductor infrastructure bellwether.

items.title: Pre-Markets in Green on Soft PPI, Falling Oil Prices and Bond Yields
bullets: U.S. Treasury yields across the 2-year, 10-year, and 30-year maturities declined following benign July producer price index data, which showed headline PPI remained unchanged against expectations of a 0.1% increase.

While headline inflation metrics appear cooling, core PPI rose 0.4% in July, exceeding the 0.3% consensus estimate and signaling persistent underlying price pressures despite the broader market rally in fixed income.
items.reason: Direct impact on benchmark interest rates and market sentiment.

items.title: Metaplanet enters Japan bond market with new BitBonds program
bullets: Metaplanet has initiated a corporate bond program dubbed 'BitBonds,' completing an inaugural ¥200 million private placement with three-year maturities and annual yields ranging between 4.0% and 4.3%.

The program utilizes the company's wholly owned securities subsidiary to distribute credit-based investment products to a broader retail and corporate investor base, marking a strategic shift in its capital structure.
items.reason: Innovative corporate debt issuance strategy in the Japanese market.

items.title: Top Links 1192 China's Polar Silk Road
bullets: China is actively expanding its 'Polar Silk Road' initiative, signaling a strategic pivot toward Arctic shipping routes to reduce reliance on traditional maritime chokepoints like the Malacca Strait.

The development of Arctic infrastructure suggests long-term shifts in global trade logistics and energy supply chains, which could significantly impact shipping costs and geopolitical risk premiums for international investors.
items.reason: Strategic shift in global trade infrastructure

items.title: Impact of USAID Funding Cuts on Global Development and Chinese Influence
bullets: Potential reductions in U.S. foreign aid create a vacuum in emerging markets that China is likely to fill through its Belt and Road Initiative, strengthening its economic leverage in the Global South.

Investors should monitor how shifting development aid dynamics influence sovereign debt profiles and infrastructure project financing in developing nations, as these factors directly affect regional market stability.
items.reason: Geopolitical influence on emerging market debt

items.title: UBS: HK home prices flat until 2027 amid rate uncertainty, cross-border investment controls
bullets: UBS forecasts stagnant home price growth through 2027, significantly trailing the market consensus of 5-6% growth, citing interest-rate uncertainty and tighter cross-border investment controls.

The firm highlights structural headwinds including a major population shortfall—with net inflows failing to meet government targets—and potential AI-driven labor disruption affecting up to 19% of the local workforce.
items.reason: Major institutional downgrade of the Hong Kong residential property outlook.

items.title: MTR Corp profits more than double to HK$15.87 billion on property gains
bullets: MTR Corporation reported a 120.7% surge in property-development profit to HK$12.23 billion, though management cautioned these are non-recurring gains tied to specific project completion schedules.

The operator plans to tender three new projects in the coming year, aiming to supply 8,000 units, while earmarking current profits for significant asset maintenance and new railway infrastructure investments.
items.reason: Significant earnings report from a bellwether stock impacting local property and infrastructure sectors.

items.title: China's AI Blitz: 10 Models in 70 Days Signals Counteroffensive Against US Big Tech
bullets: Chinese AI firms have released 10 major models in 70 days, utilizing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to achieve performance parity with US models while bypassing hardware constraints imposed by export controls.

DeepSeek’s V4 Pro demonstrates significant cost-efficiency, delivering competitive intelligence at approximately $0.06 per task, which is roughly 1/39th the cost of leading US-based alternatives like Claude Opus 5.
items.reason: Signals a major shift in global AI competitive dynamics and cost structures.

items.title: Germany's top-funded tech companies in H1 2026
bullets: Germany secured €6.3 billion in funding across 267 deals in H1 2026, with capital heavily concentrated in robotics and fintech, led by major rounds for Neura Robotics ($1.4B) and Cloover ($1.2B).

The funding landscape shows a shift toward mature, capital-intensive companies, as Series C and debt financing dominated the market, while early-stage activity remained broad but characterized by smaller ticket sizes.
items.reason: Highlights significant capital flows and sector-specific growth trends in the European tech market.

items.title: OpenAI revenue chief Denise Dresser leaving, second major executive departure in days
bullets: The departure of Chief Revenue Officer Denise Dresser, following the exit of longtime executive Brad Lightcap, creates significant leadership instability as OpenAI prepares for a high-stakes public market debut.
OpenAI is currently under intense pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation to potential investors, making the loss of key enterprise-focused leadership a critical risk to its growth strategy.
items.reason: Executive turnover during a pre-IPO phase creates significant uncertainty for valuation.

items.title: Automate legacy web applications with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser Tool
bullets: AWS is addressing a major enterprise cost center by launching a browser-based tool that allows AI agents to interact with legacy web interfaces, bypassing the need for modern APIs.

By enabling autonomous navigation of complex, multi-step workflows in legacy systems, this solution targets significant operational inefficiencies and manual data entry costs across the financial and insurance sectors.
items.reason: Direct impact on enterprise operational efficiency and cost reduction.

items.title: Global EV sales rose 9% in July – except in North America
bullets: Global EV sales reached 1.85 million units in July, marking a 9% year-over-year increase, though the market remains highly fragmented with Europe serving as the primary growth engine.

North American performance significantly lagged, with sales dropping 27% year-over-year to 140,000 units, highlighting a stark regional divergence as other markets benefit from renewed government incentives.
items.reason: Significant regional divergence in EV adoption impacting global growth projections.

items.title: US EV prices are going back up as discounts shrink
bullets: Average transaction prices for US EVs rose to $56,126 in July, representing the first annual increase since December as automakers aggressively pulled back on incentive spending.
Incentives dropped to 11.8% of the average transaction price, down from 15.8% a year ago, signaling a shift in manufacturer strategy toward margin preservation despite slowing demand.
items.reason: Indicates a shift in automaker pricing strategy and margin management in the US market.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Vantage Data Centers explores IPO at $100 billion valuation or sale, sources say
bullets: Vantage Data Centers is reportedly evaluating a potential IPO or outright sale, with the company seeking a valuation reaching $100 billion.
This move signals significant institutional interest in large-scale digital infrastructure assets as hyperscalers and AI firms aggressively compete for high-density, AI-ready data center capacity.
items.reason: Major M&A/IPO event for a top-tier industry player.

items.title: City council in Fort Worth, Texas, issues temporary data center moratorium
bullets: Fort Worth has initiated a 90-day moratorium on new data center developments to investigate concerns regarding water usage, noise, and community impact, with potential for a 90-day extension.

The city is establishing a Data Center & Infrastructure Commission (DCIC) to evaluate these impacts, creating regulatory uncertainty for developers in a key Texas market that is currently a major hub for grid-connected AI projects.
items.reason: Regulatory headwinds impacting expansion in a key data center market.

items.title: Vietnam's VinSpace signs deal with Elon Musk's SpaceX to launch its first satellites in 2027
bullets: VinSpace has secured a launch agreement with SpaceX for 2027, marking a significant expansion of SpaceX's commercial satellite launch manifest into the Southeast Asian market.

This partnership signals growing demand for sovereign satellite infrastructure in emerging economies, providing SpaceX with recurring revenue streams from international telecommunications and Earth-observation clients.
items.reason: Expansion of commercial launch partnerships in emerging markets

items.title: USSF-366 Mission - SpaceX
bullets: The USSF-366 mission represents continued collaboration between SpaceX and the U.S. Space Force, reinforcing SpaceX's dominant position as a primary launch provider for national security payloads.

Frequent government mission execution validates the reliability of the Falcon launch vehicle architecture, which remains a critical factor for SpaceX's valuation and its ability to secure high-margin defense contracts.
items.reason: Reinforces SpaceX's dominance in national security launch contracts
